data.body: Checked against origin/main on 2026-10-24: the mechanism described here no longer exists. infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py has no _seed_for and no seed-rate table, and bedrock_cap_seed_rates is gone from the terraform. Commit a069cd60ae9 (Price the Bedrock cap at a per-direction ceiling, 2026-09-24) replaced per-model rate matching with one ceiling rate per token direction; the handler docstring says there is deliberately no per-model matching, and that over-pricing a cheaper model is accepted because erring early is correct for a circuit breaker. A ladder version bump can therefore no longer fall back to a different rate. The ticket's acceptance criteria about family keying and a fail-closed fallback for unknown families do not apply to the new design. Deliberately no figures here, per the financial-figures policy.
